method: Execute original Kill handler plus original case-insensitive string matching and numeric evaluator/float truncation in isolated x86. Record named lookup/reference lookup, parts activation and death-cleanup boundaries. Independently compare return, all actor hit flags, ordered callback arguments and every other byte in each actor image.
limits: Standalone command with valid script and allocated contiguous actor pool. Malformed tokens without required separators are outside bounds.
Name/reference lookup callbacks are explicit fixture adapters, not reconstructed world binding.
Parts and death cleanup are captured dispatches; no downstream death, FX, audio, stud or body-part behavior is asserted.
Numeric evaluator has original PC finite literal/parameter execution; portable command uses an explicit numeric service.
Instruction audit corrects misleading pseudocode: single and pool paths all reject unordered NaN spawn timers when check_if_dead is enabled.
Authored commands execute against documented synthetic world bindings, not their live levels.
Managed opponent and pool references assume stable canonical bindings during service callbacks; callback mutation of native weak slots or pool membership is outside the contract.
